notes.title: Achievement Update - 1.0.1.5
notes.content:
It is now possible to unlock the achievement.

The error was due to Gamemaker Studio 2 removing all Steam features.

And gave each developer an addon, which took me 2 days to figure out how to properly add it to the game.




Sound was added to the menu.

1.0.1.5 - Charly

notes.title: Nocko is playable again! Level fix - 1.0.1.4
notes.content:
After a year I didn't notice that you can't get any further from level 10.


I have now fixed this and all levels tested several times
there were 3 erroneous levels where i misplaced a block.

I'm sorry I didn't notice

Thanks to three people from the community hub who pointed this out to me.



There is a temporary test achievement please let me know when you enter a new level.
If you don't get one, it's because of the code.

1.0.1.4 - Charly
